setup:
from sage.all import *
f = matrix(QQ, [[0,1,-1,0]])
dloc = matrix(QQ, [[-1,1,0,0],[0,0,-1,1]])
dcone = dloc.stack(f)
ker = f.right_kernel().basis_matrix().transpose()
circle = matrix(QQ, [[1,-1],[1,-1]])
tree = matrix(QQ, [[-1,1,0],[0,-1,1]])
cycle = tree.stack(matrix(QQ, [[1,0,-1]]))
R = PolynomialRing(QQ, names=('x','y'))
x,y = R.gens()
k1 = matrix(R, [[y,y]])
k2 = matrix(R, [[-y],[y]])
syzygy = vector(R,[1,-1])

checks.label: Interval cone H0 retains one constant stabilizer
Interval cone has no spurious H1
Strict fiber product lies in matched kernel
Strict interval product has same H0
Strict interval product has same H1
Redundant clean constraint Koszul differential squares zero
Clean intersection retains closed negative class
Negative class survives modulo matching ideal
checks.condition: syzygy != vector(R,[0,0]) and all(v.subs(y=0)==0 for v in k2.column(0))
